newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Karachi bourse forms committee to probe default.
newsitem.headline: Karachi bourse forms committee to probe default.

text.p: The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) on Friday formed a committee to probe a member's default that sent shivers through the market earlier this week.
The KSE suspended the membership of M. Rashid Jamal's MRJ Securities for allegedly failing to pay money owed in share transactions and to deliver sold shares on Tuesday's settlement day.

The KSE Board of Directors, in an emergency meeting on Friday, constituted a four-member committee of directors to identify the reasons of default and to suggest measures to avoid such incidents, a KSE statement said.
The KSE has so far received claims worth 75 million rupees from its members who had exposure against the MRJ, it said.
The KSE said on Wednesday it would auction MRJ Securities' trading card assets at the exchange and use the proceeds to help recover outstanding claims.
